title: 小六六对话配图：周末小事
audio_introduction: Listen to dialogues A to F. Match all six pictures to dialogues.
instruction: 听A—F六段完整对话，为全部6幅图各选相符对话的字母。没有额外规定每字母只能用一次。原卷未印遍数/时序；本机全组一遍、前后各15秒，可重播，不当原卷规则。
source_form_notice: 小六公开东城区期末原页完整六对话A—F配六图已核，正文有区/学年/学期，原校施测未认证；源音轨/脚本/键缺、遍数及复用未知。本稿完整原创对话，配套图复用自有已核几何图，不当18独立主题/曝光或儿童识图、独立难度验证。

每个标号后有完整M/W问答，六段合为一个完整大题/六回应，不算六套。完整源角色与键不凭无录音的图猜。源复用次数未印，本稿不加每项一次；无复用冲突扣分。三个版本共18图位复用12个自有单场景图，只有对话/组合新编，主题与视觉曝光不独立。脚本默认隐藏；本机合成不当源gold、独立教研、学生、商用或生产通过。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are your hands ready for lunch?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Not yet. I am washing them under the tap before I touch any food.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Would you like some help with that box?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, please. I am carrying it with both hands, but it is heavier than I expected.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Does this vehicle run on railway tracks?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. It is a bus. People get on through the door beside the front windows.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: What is that long rod for?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I am using it to catch fish. The line goes from its end down to the water.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Why are you moving that broom across the floor?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I am sweeping up the dust before we move the chairs back.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Why have you opened your umbrella?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: It has started raining, and I still have to walk to the gate.
